_comment: AGENT: always read this file via the task-index-manager skill before reading or writing any task state. System tracker for ai-worldbuilder (ADR 002).

tasks.title: Give LiveBlocks an MCP backend and drop the region-file parser
tasks.notes: From #49 / audit F2 (docs/audits/region-block-reads.md §7). block_scan_region is bulk and exact within volume≤65536 and results≤limit (default 1024); ~1.5s for a full 128×4×128 tile but ~11MB verbose text, no palette+index, not sparse. ADR 004: callers stay on BlockStore; swap LiveBlocks to MCP (tile tall cells, raise/page limit, parse text or ask for a compact encoding), keep MemoryBlocks for tests, delete the .mca reader once parity is proven. Until then keep the guarded region LiveBlocks.

tasks.title: Bake-off open and repair refuse outside the bake-off world; instructions prefix every command with the world
tasks.notes: From R-006 retro. In scripts/model_bakeoff.py, the CLI `open` and `repair` commands (NOT open_round(), which tests call with temp roots) check active_world.gameworld_id() against a `world` key added to model-bakeoffs/config.json (value 'bakeoff'; worlds/bakeoff) and refuse otherwise, printing the exact prefix `AI_WORLDBUILDER_WORLD_ROOT=$PWD/worlds/bakeoff`. Agent shells do not keep exports between calls, so SKILL.md and PROTOCOL.md must say to prefix every bake-off command with that variable (not a one-off `export`). Does not restrict world repair tools. Pairs with the no-default-world task (#57).

tasks.title: Bake-off sitting steps written once in config.json; round checklist and open card generated from it
tasks.notes: From R-006 retro. The sitting sequence is copied in SKILL.md, PROTOCOL.md, README.md, docs/model-bakeoffs.md, FAIRNESS.md and the checklist baked into each rounds/R-NNN.json, and they contradict (checklist says 'Quit Minecraft world', protocol says the world must be open for apply; both the checklist and format_sitting say 'pending task 48', which was deleted). Decided (grill): keep the steps as a list in model-bakeoffs/config.json; open_round and format_sitting render from it; the other docs link to it instead of copying. Leave existing rounds R-004..R-006 as historical records. Blocked by #58: both edit model_bakeoff.py and SKILL.md. Add one more step (from R-006 done-gate): before claiming the lock, confirm the 3x3 ghost baseline around (48,-44) is complete and clean, because a prior round's teardown leaves ghost ground without ghost features and the journal can say 'applied' while the blocks differ (R-006 left cells 47,-44 / 48,-44 / 48,-43 ghost-ground-only, with 2 reconcile drift findings). Run `cell_registry.py reconcile` over the 9 cells and `lidar_ghost status --cell 48,-44 --ring 1 --include-focus`; regenerate any cell not complete with `lidar_ghost apply --force`.
